data.title: Kitchen and Backyard Matter Hunt
data.description: Explore everyday objects to discover if they are solids, liquids, or gases!

objects.name: rock
objects.imagePrompt: A smooth gray garden rock sitting on green grass

objects.name: water
objects.imagePrompt: A clear glass filled with fresh drinking water

objects.name: air
objects.imagePrompt: Blue sky with fluffy white clouds representing open air

objects.name: sand
objects.imagePrompt: A small pile of golden playground sand on concrete

objects.name: honey
objects.imagePrompt: Golden honey dripping slowly from a wooden dipper spoon

objects.name: steam
objects.imagePrompt: Warm white steam rising gently from a hot cup of tea

challenges.instruction: Name the state of this gray, rough, and hard mystery object!
challenges.narration: I found something outdoors that is gray and rough to the touch. I wonder what state of matter it is?

challenges.instruction: Name the state of this clear, smooth, and light mystery substance!
challenges.narration: I am looking at a clear substance that takes the shape of its cup. Let us figure out its state!

challenges.instruction: Name the state of this tan, rough, and medium-weight mystery material!
challenges.narration: Even though this material can be poured into little piles, every tiny piece keeps its own shape. What state is it?

challenges.instruction: Name the state of this clear, light, space-filling mystery gas!
challenges.narration: It is all around us but we cannot always see it. Can you guess the state of this floating matter?
